verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community report that Runpod shows 'low availability' messages when deploying 4090s, which suggests some availability signal by GPU type at provisioning time. The same user says instances sometimes still fail to boot, and no first-party docs describe an availability view, API or region breakdown. missing for 10: documented real-time availability by GPU type, per-region availability visibility, API/CLI access to stock levels, first-party documentation of the availability indicator, corroboration that the signal is accurate.
